metadata.description: Defines the non-authoritative readme projection for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Readme is a projection only; authoritative values come from manifest, registry, and specifications.

summary.description: FFT AI Edition v1.3 is the fully modular, session-driven, substrate-aware architecture for AI execution of Framework Field Theory. It provides a complete runtime spine, session model, operator system, RTT mapping, regime logic, paradox handling, substrate constraints, and collapse rules.

core.description: Foundational kernel and specification of FFT AI Edition.

substrate_runtime.description: Execution substrate, compatibility, lattice, matrix, and runtime engine.

session.description: Complete session model including state, context, alignments, log, dashboard, overlay, history, UI, profile, analytics, awareness.

operators_structures.description: Operators, regimes, invariants, structures, validation, examples.

ai_runtime.description: Autonomy, discovery, execution graph, navigation, capabilities, integrations, registry, RTT spine, prompts.

rtt: RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
regime: Regime MUST match RTT node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.

non_claims: Readme does not revise RTT v0.9.
Readme does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Readme does not replace the human FFT book.
